texts.label: R9955, Charles V to Isabella, Regensburg 30 Apr 1532 (AGS Estado 496 ff. 195-196)
texts.summary: Charles V at Regensburg to the Empress Isabella, 30 April 1532 (DECODE has it as Isabella to Charles, 1531), in the general cipher AGS Estado leg. 1.1.1 doc. 112; deciphered at the time on a separate sheet, and printed by Wanruo Luo (2021) p. 285.
texts.note: Missing: no transcription and no decryption in the repository. The decipherment is on a separate sheet (images not viewed; project work), and Luo's modern edition (doctoral thesis, Universitat de València 2021, p. 285) has no link found.

texts.label: R9956, Cobos? to Juan Vázquez de Molina?, Brussels 11 Jan 1531 (AGS Estado 496 ff. 205-206)
texts.summary: A letter from Brussels, 11 January 1531, catalogued by DECODE as Isabella to Charles V; Tomokiyo reads the signature as Francisco de los Cobos ('Covos Comendador Mayor') and the addressee 'muy noble señor sobrino' as probably Juan Vázquez de Molina. Same general cipher, deciphered at the time on a separate sheet.
texts.note: Missing: no transcription and no decryption. The contemporary decipherment is on a separate sheet in the images, not viewed or transcribed (project work); not known in print.
